alignment_specification.left: B2 decoded under deterministic pamphlet printed-anchor expansion
alignment_specification.right: published B2 plaintext, A-Z only and lowercase

supported_local_interval.reason: Deleting 240 or 241 contradicts the two unanimous i observations for B2 number 241. Deleting any one of 242..246 retains 241=invariably and moves ordinary 247=design to table label 246; B2 does not use 242..245.

complete_b1_application.piecewise_rule: Use the candidate single-deletion enumeration only for labels 240..466; use the parsed pamphlet-anchor table outside that band.

printed_anchor_collision_sensitivity.classification: Frozen parser-policy sensitivity for overlapping printed-anchor intervals; the local 240..466 reconstruction is held fixed in both cases.

statistic.definition: Maximum contiguous run over the complete decoded B1 stream and both directions, where each adjacent alphabet-rank difference is zero or the chosen direction; unresolved symbols break runs.

equality_pattern_null.method: Permute decoded initials, including unresolved barriers, across B1's distinct number types; reconstruct the stream from the unchanged equality pattern.

neighbor_number_error_sensitivity.classification: Optimization after observing B1; demonstrates researcher freedom and must not be presented as a corrected ciphertext or confirmatory test.
neighbor_number_error_sensitivity.allowed_operation: At no more than k positions in one contiguous candidate run, replace the printed number n by n-1 or n+1; scan all starts and both directions.

limitations: The known B2 plaintext is used to infer constraints; this is not an independent decryption.
The global alignment is deterministic but four observed number types remain internally conflicted.
The deletion interval is identifiable, but the deleted word is not.
The alphabet statistic was formulated after the anomaly was known.
The equality-pattern null is one explicit chance model, not a probability that the hoax hypothesis is true.
Overlapping printed anchors require a parser collision policy; both frozen policies are reported.
